info.description:
Backend API for **Workflow** — a GitHub + Jira developer dashboard. Provider state is synchronized asynchronously into durable database projections; dashboard, hub, inbox, and run reads never wait for provider fan-out calls. Credential and scope changes return `202 Accepted`; consumers can follow bootstrap and freshness through `GET /api/me/hub/sync-status`.

## Authentication
Every `/me/**` route requires a Supabase-issued JWT in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header (the `bearer` security scheme). The public `/health` and `/hello/{name}` routes are unauthenticated.

## Integrations
- **GitHub** — connect a personal access token, then load the projected PR dashboard, enrich pull requests on demand, browse branches / workflows / environments, and run write actions: dispatch a workflow, create / merge / close a PR, and manage repo + workflow favorites.
- **Jira** — connect Cloud credentials (site URL + email + API token), then load the projected multi-queue dashboard, page provider queues on demand, fetch issue detail, search by JQL, and run write actions: transition, comment, assign, log work, and create / edit issues.

## Conventions
Response bodies are camelCase JSON with ISO-8601 millisecond UTC timestamps. Errors are returned as RFC 9457 `application/problem+json` carrying a stable `slug`, `title`, `detail`, and — where relevant — a `reason`.

post.summary: POST /me/ai/draft-reply — suggested reply for a ticket's QA thread.
POST /me/ai/handoff — QA handoff draft for a ticket moving to Testing.

get.summary: GET /me/ai/settings — the AI-assist toggles (all off by default).

parameters.description: Return only events with `id < before` (cursor for the next page).
parameters.name: before

Filter by `event_type` prefix, matched literally (e.g.
`"github.pull_request."`). LIKE wildcards are escaped in the DB layer.
parameters.name: typePrefix

post.summary: POST /me/github/branch — create a branch (default base: default branch).

get.summary: GET /me/github/branches — branch→PR prompts across selected repos.
GET /me/github/favorites — the user's favorite workflows per repo.

put.summary: PUT /me/github/favorites — set one repo's favorites; returns the full map.

post.summary: POST /me/github/pulls/enrich — batch-enrich the supplied PR refs.

post.summary: POST /me/github/token — validate against GitHub, then store.

get.summary: GET /me/github/workflows — active workflows across selected repos.
GET /me/hub/board — the composed kanban board + orphan tray.
GET /me/hub/inbox — the ranked Needs-you feed (+ morning brief when on).

post.summary: POST /me/hub/links — manually link a PR or branch to a ticket.

get.summary: GET /me/jira/board-mapping — the hub board's column ↔ status mapping.

get.summary: GET /me/jira/issuetypes?projectKey — issue types for a project.

post.summary: POST /me/jira/token — validate credentials against Jira, then store.

get.summary: GET /me/notes?ticketKey= — the ticket's note (empty body when none).

put.summary: PUT /me/notes?tz= — upsert the note and re-sync derived reminders/links.

post.summary: POST /me/reminders/snooze — suppress a reminder until the given instant.
